description: Source code for file system stat data handling, including functions for munging, setting, matching, and validating file stat data.

methods.name: munge_st_size
methods.description: Converts file size to unsigned int, handling exact 4 GiB multiples.

methods.name: fill_stat_data
methods.description: Fills a stat_data structure with information from a struct stat.

methods.name: set_times
methods.description: Sets the times in a struct stat from a stat_data structure.

methods.name: fake_lstat_data
methods.description: Fills a struct stat with data from a stat_data structure.

methods.name: match_stat_data
methods.description: Compares stat_data with a struct stat to detect changes.

methods.name: stat_validity_check
methods.description: Checks if the stored stat data matches the current file state.

methods.name: stat_validity_update
methods.description: Updates the stored stat data with current file info.
